Inside, the museum houses a vast collection of artifacts and exhibits that delve into the lives and struggles of Vietnamese women across centuries. 

Just a few steps away, you'll see the Vietnam Museum of Ethnology, which, like its sister institution, also plays a crucial role in preserving and showcasing the diverse cultures of Vietnam. The museum, part of the Vietnam Academy of Social Sciences, features a unique Drum Tower and an architectural garden that beautifully blend traditional Vietnamese aesthetics with contemporary design.
